title: Enterprise SSO, session, and identity administration
goal: Move AegisPT from local actor/API-key basics toward enterprise identity controls that operators can understand, configure, and audit.
scope: Design and implement the first enterprise identity administration slice: OIDC/SAML configuration model, disabled-by-default Settings surface, session expiry/logout behavior, user and role listing for local mode, clear unauthenticated/degraded states, and audit events for login/logout/key creation/revocation. This does not replace backlog-120 or backlog-127; it builds on them by making enterprise SSO/session management a concrete governed task.
generation_reason: Enterprise operators need real identity administration. Existing tasks cover API keys, ROE, and RBAC, while docs explicitly note SSO and tenant membership are still gaps. A topbar editable actor/local identity model is not enough for enterprise readiness.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: First enterprise identity slice only. Do not remove local development fallback until explicitly migrated. Do not weaken ROE, tenant isolation, or API-key revocation.

success_criteria: Settings exposes enterprise identity status with clear disabled/configured/error states.
Local mode still works, but product UI no longer implies unrestricted actor spoofing is enterprise authentication.
OIDC/SAML configuration is persisted safely without exposing secrets.
Session timeout/logout behavior is explicit and tested.
Docs state what is supported now and what remains future work for full SSO/SCIM.

acceptance_criteria: Operators can see whether enterprise SSO is disabled, configured, or failing.
Logout/session timeout behavior is visible and does not corrupt active run state.

before_promotion: NEXT_TASK.md must contain this task as the only active task.
after_completion: Promote exactly one next approved task into NEXT_TASK.md.
